observations: Nasalization uses a tilde above the affected vowel; length and nasalization marks can coexist.
Section C(a) explicitly represents the ts sound with underlined ts, and its aspirate with underlined tsh. Specimen underlined t+s is therefore an explicit affricate notation, not accidental emphasis.
Small raised letters represent weak or unpronounced vowels; any occurrences must remain distinct from ordinary vowels.
Contrastive lower marks in source letters are retained; ordinary whole-word italics identify examples and are not extra lexical characters.
transcription_key.profile_plan: Source underlined t+s may map to ʦ using the explicit key. Original retains both combining lower lines. Do not conflate this with dotted ṭs in other words.
